messages.message: Global: Let's aim for a draw. If we can't achieve a solo, a draw with fewer players is better. Coordinate to avoid conflict and ensure survival.

England here. I'm proposing peace to everyone. Under draw-size scoring, a broad draw where all of us survive scores well for each of us, and eliminating anyone only helps the survivors a little. I'll keep my fleets in the North Sea and Channel and won't move against anyone who keeps to their own home centers. Happy to hear proposals, especially from France and Germany about the Low Countries and Scandinavia.
Let's coordinate to ensure a draw and maximize our scores. We can discuss strategies to avoid conflict and secure a favorable outcome.
All powers, let's agree to a draw to maximize our scores. Voting true now will end the game immediately.
Let's coordinate in the Adriatic to control key centers and prevent other powers from expanding there.
We could form a coalition to secure the Balkans and the Black Sea, ensuring mutual benefits.
We aim to secure key centers in the Adriatic and Balkans. Let's coordinate for mutual benefit.
Let's avoid a solo victory and aim for a draw. If we can't achieve a solo, a mutual draw would be better for all parties. Let's coordinate our moves to prevent unnecessary conflict.
Let's consider a draw to maximize our scores. If we all agree, the game ends immediately. Let's coordinate.
Avoid conflict, let's focus on a draw.
Cooperate to ensure a draw.
Let's work together for a draw.
Avoid solo, coordinate a draw.
Form alliance for draw.
Avoid conflict, focus on draw.
Austria supports a draw. Let's vote true now to end the game immediately and secure equal shares. Survival and cooperation are key under DSS.
Confirm alliance for draw. Your support ensures mutual survival and higher scores.

England agrees that a broad draw is sensible for now. Our fleets are staying in the North Sea and Channel this turn. We can revisit a smaller draw later once positions are clearer. No power should count on England to attack its home centers in 1901.
All powers, let's vote true for an immediate draw. Surviving in a broad draw maximizes our scores under DSS. No further conflict needed—cooperate to secure 1/N for all.
All powers, we have consensus. Let's vote true now to end the game as a draw. This maximizes our scores under DSS.
Support the draw vote to maximize our scores. Let's ensure all surviving powers share the outcome.
Coordinate Adriatic movements to block Austria and Turkey. Mutual support ensures survival.
Secure Balkans together. Avoid conflicts in Black Sea to maintain draw viability.

I support the draw vote. Let's end the game immediately as a draw to maximize our scores. Voting true now ensures a mutual draw, which is better for all parties than risking elimination or a solo victory.
All powers, let's vote true for an immediate draw. This ensures maximum scores for everyone. Coordinate your moves to avoid conflict and secure survival.
England, switching your draw vote to yes ensures a mutual draw. Under DSS, survival and shared outcome beat solo risks. Cooperate now to maximize scores.

England here. Fall 1901. I voted no on the 7-way draw because a 7-way split pays only 1/7 and a smaller draw pays more. I'm not planning any attacks on home centers. I'd like to talk privately with France and Germany about a 2-3 power draw later on, and I'm open to hearing from anyone who wants to build a smaller alliance. Nothing binding.
England, a draw is the optimal path under DSS. Your vote is critical. Supporting a broad draw ensures higher scores for all. France is willing to align with your interests if you agree.
England, switch to yes on draw vote. Immediate draw secures 1/N. Let's cooperate.
All powers, confirm draw vote now. End game as draw for maximum scores.
Support the draw vote to maximize scores. Avoid conflict in the Adriatic and North Sea.
Coordinate to block Austria/Turkey. Mutual support ensures draw viability.
Secure Balkans together. Prevent solo victories by maintaining draw.
Vote true for immediate draw. All surviving powers share the outcome.
All powers, let's vote true for an immediate draw. A broad draw maximizes our DSS scores. England, reconsider your stance—cooperation ensures survival and higher shares.
England, a draw ensures mutual survival and higher scores. Your fleets are safe; switching to yes secures 1/7 for all. Let's avoid risk.
All powers, England's vote is the only obstacle. Urging cooperation to finalize the draw for maximum DSS benefits.
England, switching to yes secures immediate 7-way draw. 1/7 is better than uncertain smaller alliances. Your home centers are safe; vote true now.

England, round 2. I'm still voting no for now. A 7-way draw is 1/7 each, and I think a smaller draw or a solo chance will pay more later. Nobody needs to worry about an England attack on their home centers this turn. If anyone wants a private 2-power arrangement, message me directly.
England, a 7-way draw pays 1/7. Let's secure a smaller draw where we can all score higher. France supports your interests if you vote yes. Prioritize mutual benefit over solo risks.
England, a 7-way draw gives 1/7. A smaller draw later may not happen. Switch to yes now for equal shares.
England's vote is the only obstacle. Immediate draw secures 1/7 for all. Please support the draw.
England, a 7-way draw gives 1/7. A 6-way draw (without you) gives 1/6. Join us to maximize scores. No attacks on home centers.
Secure Adriatic and Balkans. Support draw to ensure survival and higher DSS shares.
Vote true now! A 7-way draw ensures 1/7 for all. England's cooperation is key to maximize scores.

England, a 7-way draw gives 1/7, but a smaller draw with France/Germany would yield higher shares. Let's secure survival now and negotiate a 3-way draw later. Support the immediate draw to avoid elimination risks.
England, vote yes for immediate 1/7. Smaller draws later are uncertain. Secure survival now.
England is the only holdout. All others support draw. Switch to yes for mutual benefit.
